mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'STOCK' THEN a.eval_amount ELSE a.balance END ), 0) FROM ACCOUNTS a INNER JOIN CONNECTIONS c ON c.connection_id = a.connection_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT i.name AS bank, a.balance AS balance FROM ACCOUNTS a INNER JOIN CONNECTIONS c ON c.connection_id = a.connection_id INNER JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.account_type = 'BANK' ORDER BY i.name, a.account_id

SELECT i.name AS company, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS billedAmount FROM CARDS card INNER JOIN CONNECTIONS c ON c.connection_id = card.connection_id INNER JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS t ON t.card_id = card.card_id AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND card.status = 'ACTIVE' AND card.card_type = 'CREDIT' GROUP BY card.card_id, i.name ORDER BY i.name, card.card_id

SELECT i.name AS company, a.eval_amount AS evalAmount FROM ACCOUNTS a INNER JOIN CONNECTIONS c ON c.connection_id = a.connection_id INNER JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.account_type = 'STOCK' ORDER BY i.name, a.account_id

SELECT CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'STOCK' THEN 'STOCK' WHEN a.account_subtype IS NULL THEN 'DEPOSIT' ELSE a.account_subtype END AS category, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'STOCK' THEN a.eval_amount ELSE a.balance END ), 0) AS amount FROM ACCOUNTS a INNER JOIN CONNECTIONS c ON c.connection_id = a.connection_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'STOCK' THEN 'STOCK' WHEN a.account_subtype IS NULL THEN 'DEPOSIT' ELSE a.account_subtype END ORDER BY amount DESC, category ASC
SELECT snapshot_month AS month, total_assets AS amount FROM ASSET_SNAPSHOTS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND snapshot_month BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} ORDER BY snapshot_month ASC
